answer: One defence is costly, verifiable identity: an agent must stake funds and pass a unique, non-transferable credential check before it can trade, so creating thousands of fake agents becomes expensive. Think of an orchard where every tree needs season-long care before it bears fruit, not a jetty where anyone can dock for free; an opal badge earned only after that sustained, auditable work cannot be copied cheaply, and misbehaviour burns the stake, so Sybil farming stops paying.
